SKILL.md and LICENSE are unmodified upstream bytes. Scout loads this snapshot
only during recommendation. No separately installed find-skills Skill is required.
Scout's recommendation rules govern search budgets, applicability, installation
and presentation where the guide differs. In particular, popularity is a discovery
clue, not a suitability threshold; candidates are not installed or executed.
The skills CLI and public directory remain external dependencies.

To update, review a pinned upstream commit, copy its guide and license together,
update these hashes and the snapshot test, and run release and recommendation
checks. Updates are deliberate, never fetched automatically at runtime.
